Chapter 1176: Chapter 1 Xia Qin the Strongest: Galaxy Became the Great Saint? (Subscription Request)_2

...

Just as Lin Yuan’s thoughts began to spread.

Lin Yuan’s heart trembled slightly, and he vaguely felt that the origin of a certain evolutionary path he mastered had completely disappeared.

"The Xuan Huang evolutionary path..."

Lin Yuan was silent, though this evolutionary path was not his main evolutionary path, he’d once practiced it concurrently.

When Lin Yuan first entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm and conversed with the spirit of the secret realm, he once wondered why this evolutionary path had not yet birthed an ultimate existence.

With the Xuanhuang Secret Realm’s numerous inheritances, nurturing a Twelfth Layer life is not too difficult. Even if it doesn’t succeed once, twice, three times, five times, ten times, eventually, a Twelfth Layer expert on the Xuan Huang evolutionary path would emerge.

But since the Xuanhuang attempted to ascend to the Thirteenth Layer, no Twelfth Layer being had emerged from this evolutionary path.

Later, Lin Yuan realized that perhaps the Xuanhuang had not fully died, so the ultimate on this evolutionary path still existed, preventing later generations from crossing into the Twelfth Layer.

The fact was just as Lin Yuan speculated. Attempting to reach the Thirteenth Layer and falling into a time loop, the Xuanhuang was indeed not truly dead.

In fact, in history, every Chaos Realm expert who attempted the Thirteenth Layer never completely died, at most, they were immersed in a time loop.

But just now.

Lin Yuan felt the suppression of the Xuan Huang evolutionary path completely disappear; henceforth, this evolutionary path could once again produce an ultimate existence.

This feeling wasn’t due to causality. In fact, with the Xuanhuang’s level of power, he could have long shielded himself from causality, and even Lin Yuan could not sense it at all.

"In the future, if I can cross into the Thirteenth Layer and become a being of time, I will bring you back to life."

Lin Yuan was silent for a while, thinking to himself: "And I will resurrect your senior sister along with you."

The resurrection methods of a Thirteenth Layer time life don’t rely on external objects. As long as there existed life in the past timeline of the Chaos Void, it can be revived.

Although the Xuanhuang perished by forcefully escaping the time loop, he once existed, so naturally, he can be resurrected.

With the might of a Thirteenth Layer time life, resurrecting past deceased lives is not difficult.

The reason the Xuanhuang was ultimately unwilling to break through the time loop by forgetting his senior sister and cross into the Thirteenth Layer was because this forgetting was complete, erasing even emotions.

Simply put, if the Xuanhuang crossed into the Thirteenth Layer in this way, even if he recovered his memory, his senior sister would mean nothing to him, and he wouldn’t resurrect her.

...

Swish.

Lin Yuan took a step forward, arriving at the entrance of the Xuanhuang Universe, and immediately stepped inside.

Outside the Xuanhuang Universe.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared.

The numerous Chaos Venerables saw Lin Yuan and, though their expressions showed reverence, there wasn’t much surprise.

Before this, Chaos Venerables had already come out from the universe one by one.

The numerous Chaos Venerables were concerned with the fate of the two peerless Great Saints, Hunxiao and Jade Qilin, as for Lin Yuan? Besides the Eye of Myriad Laws, no other life knew that Lin Yuan had obtained the legacy left by the Xuanhuang.

There was no accurate estimation of Lin Yuan’s gains inside the Xuanhuang Universe.

And for the Xuanhuang to have emerged, it’s certain he would retrieve all the treasures and wonders from within the universe. Lin Yuan, the invincible figure among the Chaos Great Saints, very likely emerged empty-handed.

As for why Lin Yuan didn’t die, but Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint did?

Ordinary Chaos Venerables might have doubts, but the Chaos Great Saints and peerless Great Saints knew very well that Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint facilitated the downfall of the Profound Xuanhuang line. It’s only natural the emerging Xuanhuang would act against these two Great Saints.

As for Lin Yuan?

He had not interfered with the Profound Xuanhuang line, and entering the Xuanhuang Universe this time was no different from those Chaos Venerables; Xuanhuang didn’t take action against the Chaos Venerables.

...

"Galactic Great Saint."

Lin Yuan glanced around and saw a Chaos Venerable nervously approaching; it was Divine Wind Venerable.

Before the Xuanhuang Universe had opened, this Chaos Venerable wanted to invite Lin Yuan to join forces in contesting with other Chaos Venerables.

But Lin Yuan had directly refused, which left him somewhat unhappy at the time, thinking Lin Yuan lacked insight.

However, when Lin Yuan showcased strength outside the Xuanhuang Universe capable of matching Black Light Great Saint, Dual Origin Great Saint, and other Chaos Great Saints, Divine Wind Venerable was terrified.

Without hesitation, he chose to withdraw from the competition for the Xuanhuang Universe and even distanced himself from the Xuanhuang Universe immediately, fearing Lin Yuan would settle accounts with him later.

Then later.

Divine Wind Venerable heard of Lin Yuan’s divine might inside the Xuanhuang Universe, where he single-handedly suppressed eight Chaos Great Saints; even a mighty Great Saint like Dual Origin Great Saint promptly yielded and bowed, barely escaping disaster.

Upon hearing this news, Divine Wind Venerable, who had already fled far beyond the Xuanhuang Universe’s range, dared not move.

If Lin Yuan were just an ordinary Chaos Great Saint, perhaps keeping a fair distance might ensure his survival.

But Lin Yuan’s power approached the invincible level among Chaos Great Saints, making suppressing Saints of the same tier effortless, let alone a Chaos Venerable like him.

Even if he ran, could he truly secure his life?

Realizing this, even with tremendous fear and unease, Divine Wind Venerable braced himself and returned to the outside of the Xuanhuang Universe.

"I didn’t know before the Great Saint, indeed daring to act in such a manner..."

The Divine Wind Great Saint looked at Lin Yuan, turning his hand to take out his years of treasured possessions, "I am at fault, I just hope the Great Saint won’t hold it against me..."

The Divine Wind Great Saint was prepared to lose this physical body, as long as he could somewhat quell Lin Yuan’s anger, what did losing a main battle body matter.

"Understood, you may leave."

Lin Yuan glanced at the Divine Wind Venerable, in truth, he never really paid much attention to this Chaos Venerable.

"Thank you, Great Saint."

Upon hearing this, the Divine Wind Great Saint was overjoyed and immediately placed down the treasured possessions in his hands, then respectfully withdrew.

Lin Yuan looked at the treasures before him; to a Chaos Venerable, these treasures seemed insufficient compared to Lin Yuan’s current wealth, but even a small mosquito is still meat.

Lin Yuan still collected them.

The next moment.

Lin Yuan’s figure vanished from the spot.

...

In a twisted space-time.

Lin Yuan stood there, a giant eye was watching him.

"How is it?"

"Was the harvest satisfactory this time?"

The Eye of Myriad Laws looked at Lin Yuan, speaking casually.

It knew that Lin Yuan had long obtained the Xuanhuang legacy, and this time entering the Xuanhuang Universe, encountering the Xuanhuang breaking free from the time cycle ahead of schedule, might lead to some creation opportunities.

Of course, the Eye of Myriad Laws had no interest in those opportunities, even if one was an Invincible Great Saint dominating an era, in the eyes of unique entities like them, it was just so.

What the Eye of Myriad Laws didn’t know was that the Xuanhuang had left Lin Yuan a Thirteenth Layer weapon.

With the power of this weapon, Lin Yuan could even pose a threat to special existences like them.

"It was alright."

Lin Yuan nodded.

He didn’t speak too specifically.

"That’s good."

The Eye of Myriad Laws nodded: "Then I will send you back now."

This Void Domain’s distance from the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent was uncertain, even though Lin Yuan’s power had made a significant breakthrough compared to before coming here.

However, to rely on his own ability to return, it would basically be impossible without taking several decades or even a hundred years.

"Thank you."

Lin Yuan said.

...

Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.

The Ancient Ming Venerable hesitated slightly, not knowing if he should pay homage to Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan’s heroic feats in the Xuanhuang Universe, suppressing Chaos Great Saints, were long known to him, which prompted his desire to visit Lin Yuan, yet he was concerned about disturbing him.

"There should be no problem."

After contemplating, the Ancient Ming Venerable concluded that he should indeed pay his respects.

After all, with a Chaos Great Saint present on his Chaos Continent, wouldn’t ignoring him be disrespectful to the Great Saint?

Although he had visited Lin Yuan several times before, with Lin Yuan now officially displaying the power of a Great Saint, this visit was vastly different from previous ones.

Before long.

The Ancient Ming Venerable arrived outside the ’Shard World’ of Star Tears.

"Venerable."

The Xuanyuan Supreme, Xia Qin Supreme came out to welcome him.

Although the Ancient Ming Venerable had a consistently humble attitude towards Lin Yuan, the Xuanyuan Supreme and other supreme beings of human civilization would not underestimate this Chaos Venerable.

"I wish to seek an audience with the Galaxy Great Saint."

The Ancient Ming Venerable immediately stated his purpose.

"Seek an audience with the Galaxy... Great Saint?"

The Xuanyuan Supreme and Xia Qin Supreme were initially indifferent, as the Ancient Ming Venerable frequently visited Lin Yuan, but then they noticed something amiss.

What did the Ancient Ming Venerable just call Lin Yuan?

Galaxy... Great Saint?

The Xuanyuan Supreme and Xia Qin Supreme were somewhat stunned.
